name: Patna
type: city; urban area; big city; state capital; largest city
text: Patna (Hindi: Paṭanā, pronounced [ˈpəʈnaː] ), historically known as Pāṭaliputra, is the capital and largest city of the Indian state of Bihar. According to the United Nations, as of 2026, Patna had a population of 3.33 million, making it the 19th largest city in India. Covering 250 square kilometres (97 sq mi) and over 2.5 million people, its urban agglomeration is the 18th largest in India.

depictions.name: Patna
depictions.text: Patna is known as the capital of India. It is also the city in which the Maharajah and Kalim reside in Battles of Prince of Persia.
